detailed_description: Semi-realistic 3D animated Chinese suspense drama: natural-size expressive eyes with restrained animation stylization, sculpted yet natural facial planes, believable adult proportions, soft skin subsurface scattering, fine separated hair strands, realistic woven cloth and wood. Soft motivated key light, gentle fill and contact shadows, neutral skin tones, restrained color, readable midtones, controlled highlights. Faces are the visual priority; detailed three-dimensional rooms recede gently behind them.
[Shot 1] The visible lead is <Subject 2>. A small contemporary streaming room at night. Dark wood desk, bronze coin, brush and worn notebook. A large soft warm desk-lamp key models the face; restrained cool monitor fill comes from camera right. The wall and shelves remain visible in soft shadow. CHEN BUFAN is a lean Chinese man aged 28, narrow oval face, straight brows, naturally proportioned expressive eyes matching the identity reference, short layered black hair, faded charcoal crew-neck T-shirt. His movements are economical and his voice is low, clear Mandarin. Eye-level medium close-up, 50mm perspective. CHEN rests two fingers on the bronze coin. He looks directly at the camera, speaking calmly. The camera inches forward by five percent and settles on his eyes. CHEN BUFAN (S1) says: <d>[Chinese]今日三卦，善缘半价，恶人翻倍。</d> Maintain stable facial anatomy and object geometry throughout. Motion is restrained and physically coherent. Leave the image clean for later subtitles and interface graphics; no generated lettering, floating comments or split screen.
